# Ryse ABA Therapy

> In-home and community-based ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) therapy for autism, serving families across Southern Utah (Washington County). Ages 2-65. BCBA-led, family-first, no waitlist. "When we Ryse together, we achieve more."

## Key facts
- Service model: in-home & community-based ABA (therapy delivered in the home and community, not a clinic)
- Areas served: St. George, Washington, Hurricane, Santa Clara, Ivins, La Verkin, Cedar City (Southern Utah / Washington & Iron County)
- Ages: 2 to 65
- No waitlist — families start right away
- BCBA-led (Clinical Director: Noah Rasmussen, BCBA)
- Insurance accepted (autism diagnosis + active coverage required); we verify benefits for free
- Phone: (385) 549-5656 · Email: jbailey@ryseabatherapy.com
